_comment: Request data next to the account flow (docs/Extensions_Overlay.md). The account flow has no line level: its rows are signatures aggregated by stage, account, document type, origin and transaction, so a request number or a source system per row would split the matrix (and the link item -> request log CD_ITEM_TO_REQUEST is pending V82). Declared blocked so the gap stays visible (decision D-H3); the request drill-down is the payment trace and the link walker.

extensions.description: Request number and source system of a flow row
extensions.reason: Flow rows are aggregated - no line to join (D-H3)
